system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Earth. No item slots. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Proficiency[3], Thug, Harm

You have a mantra of power that resonates from your core.

Core Mantra (Passive): When you use the Harm action against a target to whom you have given Wrestle Pin, increase the dice type by one type.

Rulebook p.47.
